stories.headline: Google's Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics: 87% on the ERQA embodied-reasoning benchmark
stories.summary: Google's developer blog (Oct. 13) presents Argon as a physical-reasoning model, scoring 87% on ERQA, which it says tops other frontier models. It reports simulation-generated data lifting a real-world success rate from 56% to 75%, and availability via Google AI Studio, the Gemini API (paid tier) and Antigravity for AI Ultra. Moomoo's headline says Argon is open globally.
stories.whyItMatters: The figures are Google's own claims from its blog; this extends Argon, launched Oct. 1, into robotics tooling.
